_about: Service providers' Appointments, Services & packages, Availability, Clients, Group classes, Requests & quotes (design board 6, requirements section 42). Read by clp-api shared/events-services.mjs and events-clients.mjs, synced to the admin by sync-widgets. The PAR-Q questions follow the standard PAR-Q; have the wording confirmed before launch.
contexts: Training, S&C or high intensity: health questions (PAR-Q)
Nutrition or dietitian: health intake and consent
Photo or video shoot: shoot agreement

questions.ask: Has a doctor ever said they have a heart condition and should only do physical activity a doctor recommends?
Do they feel pain in their chest during physical activity?
In the past month, have they had chest pain when not doing physical activity?
Do they lose their balance because of dizziness, or ever lose consciousness?
Do they have a bone or joint problem that a change in physical activity could make worse?
Is a doctor prescribing medication for their blood pressure or a heart condition?
Is there any other reason they shouldn’t do physical activity?
